utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the carpool's still on track, but I should check whether anyone's got extra seats this morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good. I'll check with my driver and see if I can offer an extra seat.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, let me know what your driver says. If there’s an extra seat, I can pass that along right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can do that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, I’ll handle my part.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’m on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the carpool is still on for tomorrow, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I think so, unless anything changes with the pickup times.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just text me if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the carpool. I may have mixed up the time, but I can still make it if you give me the details again.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, it’s 7:15 at the west curb by the library. I’ll text you if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Got it, 7:15 at the west curb by the library. I’ll keep an eye out for your text.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the carpool. I may have missed the update, can you remind me what changed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I think the pickup moved to 4:30, and Jamie’s car is taking the first two stops now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what did I miss about the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’ve got the carpool set: Maya’s driving, I’m covering the pickup list, and you’re on for the 8:10 spot.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m on the 8:10 spot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can handle the carpool this week if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Sam. I appreciate it, and I can bring by the cooler if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That would be great, Gus. I’ll take the cooler with me when I do the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can take the lead on the pickup list if that helps. Just tell me who’s riding and where everyone needs to be.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, send me the riders and each pickup/drop-off spot, and I’ll keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool might be running a little early tomorrow, so keep an eye out. I can check with the others if you want.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh good, thanks for the heads-up. I’ll be ready a little early and can help spread the word to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, I’ll pass that along too and make sure everyone’s looped in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you tell me what time the carpool leaves?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m not sure yet, but I can check.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Could you check and let me know?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can take the first run if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps. Just let me know what time you’re thinking.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: How about 8:00? That should work for the first run.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Klar, ich organisiere die Fahrgemeinschaft und schicke dir gleich die Zeiten.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Danke, das hilft mir sehr. Ich schicke dir gleich auch meine Zeiten.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Super, danke dir. Schick sie mir einfach, dann gleiche ich alles ab und melde mich mit dem Plan.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the carpool might need one more driver this week.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I can take that shift if needed. Just let me know the time and I’ll plan on it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll check the time and let you know as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — what time are we leaving for the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We’re leaving at 8. I’ll repeat it to everyone when they get here.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, I’ll be there at 8.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Morning works for me, if that’s not too early.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Morning is fine with me. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can do carpool. Just tell me what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: What time works for you?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mornings are best for me, around 8:00 works.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sure, I can help with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks. What time were you thinking for pickup?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: How about pickup at 7:30? That should give us a little cushion if traffic is slow.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the carpool... I think I missed the latest change. What time are we leaving?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We’re leaving at 7:30. I can text you the updated pickup spot too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, 7:30 works. Send me the pickup spot when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can take the next shift if that helps with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That'd help a lot. I can cover the next one if you want.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I can cover the one after that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help with the carpool. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: How about 7:30?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: 7:30 works for me. I can be there on time.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can probably do the afternoon run, but I need to know the exact pickup times first so I can check the route.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time exactly can you do pickup?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do 3:30 if that works, but I need the pickup order to make sure I can stay on schedule.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I can ask around and see who’s in for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Quinn. I’ll keep an eye on whether we need any extra spots or supplies for the ride.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll ask around and let you know who’s in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do the morning run on Tuesday and Thursday, if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That helps a lot. I can handle the afternoon run on those days.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, then I’ll take the morning runs Tuesday and Thursday, and you’ve got the afternoons.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I can keep an eye on the carpool list and make sure everyone’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll go by whatever you update me with.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Of course, I’ll keep the list current and let you know if anything changes.
